mapper.select: select R.no as room_no, Q.status, Q.question_started_at as phase_started_at, Q.question_ended_at as phase_ended_at from room R join qna_room Q on R.no = Q.room_no where Q.room_no = #{roomNo}
select R.no as room_no, Q.status, Q.voting_started_at as phase_started_at, Q.voting_ended_at as phase_ended_at from room R join qna_room Q on R.no = Q.room_no where Q.room_no = #{roomNo}
select room_no, question_started_at, question_ended_at, voting_started_at, voting_ended_at, status from qna_room where room_no = #{roomNo}
mapper.update: update qna_room set voting_started_at=#{startedAt}, voting_ended_at=#{endedAt} where room_no = #{roomNo}
mapper.select: select 1 from participant where no =#{participantNo} and room_no = #{roomNo}
